description: This PHP class 'InfoArray' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Maintenance plugin. It encapsulates two arrays, 'matchArray' and 'parameterArray', initialized from a provided strategy info array, and provides getter methods for accessing these properties.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Maintenance\Dto\InfoArray
classes.description: A data transfer object class that stores matching and parameter arrays provided during construction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes matchArray and parameterArray from the provided strategy info array.

methods.name: getMatchArray
methods.description: Returns the match array or null.

methods.name: getParameterArray
methods.description: Returns the parameter array or null.
